name: 21Shares Solana Staking ETP
exchange: SIX Swiss Exchange / Euronext Amsterdam (ASOL.AS / ASOL.PA)
blurb: ASOL is a European exchange-traded product (ETP) issued by 21Shares that provides physically-backed exposure to Solana (SOL), a proof-of-stake blockchain. The product passes staking yields to holders. It is not a photonics or semiconductor company. Its inclusion in @Ren_aramb's list alongside photonics names suggests it is being held as part of a broader AI/crypto/growth basket rather than a pure photonics play.
recent: As of late April 2026, ASOL was trading near 57.06 (in ETP units), with approximately $1.45B in assets under management. Solana has benefited from sustained institutional interest in proof-of-stake networks and the broader crypto risk-on environment of 2025–2026. Coverage note: this is a European ETP, not a US-listed equity.
